name: jstrain2.2
description: An interactive upskilling app that takes you from beginner to mid-level CRUD web developer across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node, SQL, C# and .NET.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run start -w server
scripts.check: npm run check:content && npm run check -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run test -w client
scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check && npm run build
scripts.drills:verify: npm --prefix jstrain run verify:solutions && npm --prefix jstrain run verify:solutions:types
